conversation.content:
Based on the search results, I now have the dates for all three figures:
- William Shakespeare: c. 23 April 1564 – 23 April 1616
- Elizabeth I: 7 September 1533 – 24 March 1603
- Elizabeth II: 21 April 1926 – 8 September 2022

Let me verify the overlap:
- Shakespeare lived 1564-1616
- Elizabeth I lived 1533-1603
- Elizabeth II lived 1926-2022

Shakespeare's life (1564-1616) overlapped with Elizabeth I's life (1533-1603) for 39 years (1564-1603), from Shakespeare's birth until Elizabeth I's death. Shakespeare did not overlap with Elizabeth II's life at all, as he died in 1616, well before she was born in 1926.

Answer: Shakespeare's life was far more contemporary with Queen Elizabeth I. Shakespeare lived from 1564 to 1616, overlapping with Elizabeth I's reign from 1558 to 1603 (a 39-year overlap), while Elizabeth II lived from 1926 to 2022—well after Shakespeare's death.

Source: William Shakespeare, Elizabeth I, Elizabeth II
